description: With an unknown for_each, an attribute that would fail to evaluate is unknown instead
notes: The README says an unknown for_each generates a single block whose iterator key and value are unknown, so that attributes derived from the iteration are unknown, which leaves the other attributes as they are. hashicorp/hcl replaces every attribute of the generated block, and of the blocks nested in it, with the dynamic value without evaluating it (unknownBody in ext/dynblock/unknown_body.go), so the undefined variable nope isn't reported.
